backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation drops from 8 to 4 steps). In a 300 s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Lower total batch to 2**18

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (accum 2). Consider lowering MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.035 if desired, but keep the change minimal: only the batch size.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**17

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at full LR before the decay.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for a longer linear decay phase.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so that the LR does not hit exactly zero at the end of the time budget.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize the first steps, which is especially useful if the batch size is reduced.
backlog.title: Short warmup

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; if HEAD_DIM 128 needs it, keep dim a multiple of 128). This yields faster steps and more tokens in 300 s. Verify the dim is divisible by HEAD_DIM, otherwise set ASPECT_RATIO = 85 to get 512.
backlog.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 (dim 510 → round to a multiple of 128 as the code does) or keep 64; test whether a bigger model wins despite fewer steps. Lower DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if OOM.
backlog.title: Depth 10

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving twice as many attention heads at the same width. Check that the rotary and value-embedding code adapts via n_head computed from model_dim // HEAD_DIM.
backlog.title: HEAD_DIM 64

backlog.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" (or equivalent) so fewer layers use full attention, which speeds up steps; the last layer is always full attention.
backlog.title: Window pattern SSSS plus final L

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" to test whether full context in all layers helps more than the speed it costs.
backlog.title: Window pattern all L

backlog.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for the Muon matrices.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.8 for the token embedding Adam group.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.8

backlog.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 for lm_head.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 for the per-layer scalars, since 0.5 may be too high.
backlog.title: Scalar LR 0.25

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay; short runs often need less regularization.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3 and keep any existing schedule on it; test stronger decay.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.3 with linear decay

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95) for the Adam groups.
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99

backlog.spec: Change the Muon momentum schedule so that the final momentum is 0.97 (instead of the current value, probably 0.95), ramped as the code currently does. If the schedule is time-based, keep the ramp timing.
backlog.title: Muon momentum ramp to 0.97

backlog.spec: Reduce the Newton-Schulz iteration count in Muon from 5 to 4 if it is a parameter, for a small speed gain with little loss of orthogonalization quality.
backlog.title: Muon NS steps 4

backlog.spec: Replace the MLP activation relu(x)^2 by a gated SiLU MLP with hidden size 8/3*dim rounded to a multiple of 64 so the parameter count stays equal. Update init for the new gate projection.
backlog.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-lite

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap constant (probably 15 or 30) in the forward pass to 15 if it is not that already, otherwise to 30, to test sensitivity.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Ensure that attention c_proj and MLP c_proj are zero-initialized, if they are not already. If they are, scale the init of the lm_head by 0.5 instead.
backlog.title: Untie init: zero-init output projections

backlog.spec: If the model is compiled with torch.compile default mode, try mode="max-autotune-no-cudagraphs" to get faster kernels. Compile time is not counted in the 300 s but must stay within the 450 s startup+train cap.
backlog.title: Compile with max-autotune-no-cudagraphs

backlog.spec: Set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32, keeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE, to check whether the smaller micro-batch is faster per token on A100 (less memory pressure). Accumulation doubles automatically.
backlog.title: Device batch 32 without accumulation change

backlog.spec: If value embeddings are applied only on alternating layers, apply them to every layer (adds parameters in embeddings, cheap compute). If already on all layers, remove them from the first layer.
backlog.title: Value-embedding on all layers

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown multiplier with a cosine one: for progress p in the warmdown phase, lr_mult = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*(1-remaining_fraction))). Keep the same WARMDOWN_RATIO.
backlog.title: Cosine-shaped warmdown

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (gradient accumulation 2 at DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64) while keeping DEPTH = 6 and everything else unchanged. Earlier run reached official 1.0613, better than the incumbent 1.0654. This slot serves as a replicate to confirm the gain is real.
backlog.title: Batch 2**17 with depth 6 replicate

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**16 so that with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 and sequence length 2048 each step needs no accumulation (or minimal). Leave the other hyperparameters unchanged. Small-batch regimes give many more optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s. If unstable, scale MATRIX_LR by 0.7.
backlog.title: Batch 2**16 no accumulation

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 4 and ASPECT_RATIO = 128 so model_dim is 512 (4 heads of 128). Fewer layers give faster steps, and the width is kept so capacity stays similar. Keep other hyperparameters unchanged. Check that the dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM.
backlog.title: Depth 4 wider model

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 5 with ASPECT_RATIO = 76 so model_dim is 380, rounded up to 384 if the code does not round on its own. Ensure it is a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128. This tests whether still faster steps beat the loss in depth. Other settings unchanged.
backlog.title: Depth 5 model

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 so the LR ramps linearly from 0 over the first 3% of the time budget. This is meant to help stability with the higher Adam embedding LR and small batches. Do not change the warmdown.
backlog.title: Short LR warmup

backlog.spec: Change the Muon momentum ramp so it ends at 0.97 instead of its current final value, and set ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.99). Both are common choices for short runs. This one change touches optimizer smoothing only.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.97 and Adam beta2 0.99

backlog.spec: Reduce the logit softcap constant in the forward pass (currently probably 30) to 15. Tanh softcapping bounds logits and sometimes helps small-model training. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon. With only about 300 s of training, heavy decay may slow down learning. If the code has a decay schedule that follows the LR, keep it as is.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" so every layer uses full-context attention instead of the SSSL mix. With a short training and a small model, the cost of full attention under flash attention is modest and the quality may improve. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: All-long attention window

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 together. A shorter warmdown spends more of the budget at peak LR, and a faster lm_head Adam LR suits the short budget. This is a bolder two-knob change, so keep the rest of the file as is.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3 with higher unembedding LR

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (grad accumulation 2 at DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64) with everything else unchanged. The earlier single run gave 1.0613 (-0.0041 vs incumbent); this is a replicate to confirm it beats the incumbent mean of 1.0654.
backlog.title: Batch 2**17 with depth 6 replicate

backlog.spec: Combine TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17, WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 and WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 in one run. Each was a small gain individually, so test whether they stack.
backlog.title: Batch 2**17 plus warmup 0.03 and warmdown 0.3

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 5 with ASPECT_RATIO = 77 so model_dim is about 384, rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM (128). Use ASPECT_RATIO = 77 only if dim comes out as 384, otherwise set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 for dim 400→ round to 384 via the existing rounding code. The goal is a faster step at similar quality. Check that the window pattern and value-embedding layer alternation still work with an odd depth.
backlog.title: Depth 5 model

backlog.spec: Change the logit soft-capping constant (currently probably 30) to 15 in the forward pass, i.e. logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15). Leave the rest unchanged.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" so every layer uses full-context attention. At depth 6 and sequence length 2048 the short windows may hurt more than they save. If the flash-attention kernel is slower, keep the change only if val_bpb improves.
backlog.title: All-long attention window

backlog.spec: Reduce the Muon orthogonalization Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4. This shaves optimizer time per step and gives slightly more steps in 300 s. Make no other change.
backlog.title: Muon Newton-Schulz steps 4

backlog.spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.8 and lower SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 together. These are the untested Adam group learning rates; the embedding likely benefits from a larger rate when steps are few.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.8 with scalar LR 0.25

memo:
Helped: changes that give more optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s. Batch 2**19 to 2**18 gave -0.0196 (official 1.0949). DEPTH 6 gave a further -0.0295 (1.0659/1.0650; incumbent mean_adjusted 1.0654). Slot 4 has a tripwire flag, though it was replicated (2 runs). Check the flag before building on it.
Did not help (all within about ±0.001 unless noted): depth 10 with batch 32 (-0.0005), HEAD_DIM 64 (+0.0071), cosine warmdown (+0.0001), SwiGLU (+0.0002), value embeddings on every layer (+0.0004), FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.05 (+0.0003), MATRIX_LR 0.05 (-0.0000), DEPTH 4 with ASPECT_RATIO 128 (+0.0004), smaller lm_head init (+0.0006), momentum 0.97 with betas (0.9, 0.99) (+0.0027, worse). WARMUP_RATIO 0.03 (-0.0008) and WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.3 with UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.008 (-0.0019) were rejected as small.
Next: replicate batch 2**17 (official 1.0613, -0.0041, rejected, so it may beat the incumbent). Combine it with the small gains from warmup 0.03 and warmdown 0.3. Try depth 5. Avoid more schedule-shape, head-dim and init tweaks.
